title: Carbon nanotubes
effect: rolled-up carbon sheets are stronger than steel and conduct like metal

title: Graphene
effect: a one-atom sheet of carbon carries electrons extremely fast and blocks every gas

title: Graphene passes protons
effect: graphene lets protons through but stops every atom and molecule

title: Metamaterials
effect: tiny repeated structures bend light, sound or radio the 'wrong' way

title: Topological insulators
effect: some crystals conduct only along their surface, where nothing scatters the current

title: Perovskite solar crystals
effect: cheap printable crystals turn sunlight into current almost as well as silicon

title: Optogenetics
effect: light-sensitive proteins let a flash of light switch chosen nerve cells on or off

title: CRISPR-Cas9
effect: a guided enzyme cuts DNA at any spot spelled out by a short RNA

title: Metal-organic frameworks
effect: sponge-like crystals with a huge inner surface trap one chosen gas

title: Bose-Einstein condensate
effect: atoms cooled almost to absolute zero behave as a single wave

title: Entanglement shown at a distance
effect: measuring one entangled particle instantly fixes its partner's state, and any snooping shows

title: RNA interference
effect: double-stranded RNA silences the matching gene

title: Induced stem cells
effect: four genes turn an adult cell back into a stem cell that can become any tissue

title: Green fluorescent protein
effect: a jellyfish protein makes any cell that carries its gene glow green

title: Spin-transfer torque
effect: a current of spin-aligned electrons can flip a tiny magnet

title: Memristor
effect: a device whose resistance remembers how much current passed through it

title: Attosecond pulses
effect: lasers can make flashes short enough to freeze electrons moving in atoms

title: Gut microbiome
effect: the bacteria in the gut steer the body's immunity, weight and mood

title: Magic-angle graphene
effect: two graphene sheets twisted by 1.1 degrees become a superconductor

title: Quantum dots
effect: crystals a few nanometres wide glow in a colour set purely by their size

title: Senescent cells
effect: clearing out worn-out 'zombie' cells makes old mice healthier

title: Immune checkpoints
effect: releasing the immune system's brakes lets it kill tumours

title: CAR-T cells
effect: immune cells given a designed receptor hunt down a chosen target

title: Lotus effect
effect: microscopic bumps make water bead up and roll off, carrying dirt away

title: Self-healing materials
effect: capsules in a plastic burst when it cracks and glue the crack shut

title: Tardigrade proteins
effect: certain proteins turn glassy inside cells and let them survive drying out

title: Quantum algorithms
effect: qubits in superposition can solve some problems, like factoring, exponentially faster

title: Magnetic skyrmions
effect: tiny stable magnetic whirls can be pushed along a wire with very little current

title: Glymphatic system
effect: during deep sleep the brain flushes out waste through fluid channels

title: Giant electrocaloric effect
effect: an electric field makes certain thin films heat up or cool down

title: GLP-1 hormone action
effect: a gut hormone curbs appetite and steadies blood sugar

title: Synthetic genome
effect: a cell can run on a genome written entirely by computer

title: Plastic-eating enzyme
effect: bacteria found at a recycling plant make an enzyme that breaks PET plastic apart

title: DNA origami
effect: DNA strands fold themselves into any designed nanoscale shape

title: Cryo-electron microscopy
effect: flash-frozen molecules can be imaged atom by atom with electrons

title: Protein structure prediction
effect: a learned model predicts a protein's 3D shape from its sequence

title: Daytime sky cooling
effect: a surface that reflects sunlight and glows in infrared cools below air temperature in full sun

title: Electron fluids
effect: in very clean materials electrons flow like a viscous liquid

title: Brain-computer interface
effect: electrodes on the motor cortex let a person's intent move a cursor or arm

title: Laser guide stars
effect: a laser makes sodium atoms high in the sky glow as an artificial star for correcting blur
